objective: Add three handler functions to app/api.py: handle_export_pdf (POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf returning 202 with job_id), handle_get_job (GET /jobs/{id} returning job state), handle_download_job (GET /jobs/{id}/download returning PDF bytes or 409/404), plus tests/test_api_pdf.py with unit tests for all three endpoints including error cases

concepts: handler function pattern from existing api.py (path_params + body -> tuple[int, dict])

frozen_contracts.spec: JobStore interface: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id (str); get(job_id) -> Job | None where Job = {id, customer_id, report_id, lang, status: pending|running|done|failed, result: bytes|None, error: str|None, created_at: str}. Status transitions: pending->running (worker picks up), running->done (PDF generated), running->failed (exception). No other transitions allowed.

POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf: body {lang: str (optional, default 'en')} -> 202 {job_id: str}. 404 if report_id unknown. 400 if lang not in {en, de}. GET /jobs/{id} -> 200 {job_id, status, result_available: bool, error: str|None}. 404 if job unknown. GET /jobs/{id}/download -> 200 (application/pdf bytes) if done, 409 if not done, 404 if unknown.

allowed_dependencies.what: JobStore class from app.services.jobstore (create, get methods)

non_goals: Do not modify app/services/export.py, app/services/pdf_export.py, app/services/jobstore.py, app/services/i18n.py, or app/models.py
Do not add authentication or rate limiting
Do not add request validation beyond lang check and report existence
Do not modify the existing handle_export_csv function
implementation_constraints: Follow existing handler pattern: function(path_params: dict, body: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]
Import report_with_rows from app.queries for the 404 check on report_id
handle_export_pdf: validate lang first (400 if not en/de), then check report exists (404 if not), then create job (202)
handle_get_job: return 404 if job not found, otherwise 200 with {job_id, status, result_available, error}
handle_download_job: return 404 if job not found, 409 if status not done, 200 with PDF bytes if done

deliverables.what: Three new handler functions (handle_export_pdf, handle_get_job, handle_download_job)
Unit tests for all three endpoints including error cases

acceptance_tests.description: handle_export_pdf with valid report_id returns (202, {'job_id': <non-empty string>})
handle_get_job for a known job returns (200, {'job_id': ..., 'status': ..., 'result_available': ..., 'error': ...})
handle_download_job for a pending job returns (409, {'error': ...})

failure_cases.expected_behavior: Return 404 with error message before creating a job
Return 400 with error message before creating a job

failure_cases.scenario: job status is not 'done' on download

handoff.notes: Handlers follow the existing pattern in api.py. The JobStore is imported from app.services.jobstore — T03 uses a test fake of JobStore in unit tests (frozen C1 interface).
